decision: ADR-014 and ADR-015; executive entry and five specialist local-demo reports
release_policy: Each business virtual dataset has one literal ever-published release ID. Release-specific dashboards are retained; publication alone does not mutate assets.
formula_owner: Eight core KPIs: existing MetricFlow exports. Extended customer/cohort/delivery/payment analysis: versioned published SQL views and analysis/sql, with separate oracle checks.

presentation.policy: Compact business title/context, button navigation, KPIs, findings and charts. Methodology stays in chart descriptions/docs; technical provenance stays on the trust page.
presentation.verification: No repeated boilerplate on all six pages; overview KPI cards fit the first 1720/1366 desktop viewport, while numeric and navigation evidence remains required.

navigation.policy: Actual in-dashboard links retain published release and selected month using Superset native-filter URL state. Customer/trust month selectors affect navigation only, not fixed business scope.
navigation.idempotency: Two bootstraps with unchanged catalog/context retain dataset/chart/dashboard IDs and asset counts.

commentary.monthly_policy: Overview/sales/commercial/service commentary is queried and filtered by the same single purchase_month as its KPI/breakdown; never a static paragraph with default-month numbers.
commentary.fixed_policy: Customer observations use cutoff 2018-08-31; trust observations pin the producer/release and do not summarize live attempts as that producer.
commentary.missing_policy: A missing or zero denominator is explicitly insufficient data, not a fabricated 0% change or rate.
commentary.verification: Compare actual API findings to separately executed analytical SQL/arithmetic; browser checks visible findings and month changes on all four monthly boards without repeated methodology panels.

dashboards.question: Business magnitude/change, leading contributors and eligible delivery observations; where to investigate next?
filters: single purchase_month for eight KPIs, commentary, contributions and navigation; trends keep historical context

dashboards.question: Delivered merchandise, orders, distinct customers, AOV, cancellations and monthly comparisons?
filters: single purchase_month for KPIs/daily chart/commentary/navigation; trends retain 2017-01 to 2018-08 context

dashboards.question: Observed repeat purchase, recency and cohort retention?
filters: fixed full observation cutoff; selected month filters navigation only, never customer history

dashboards.question: Eligible on-time deliveries, duration, methods and installments?
Producer run, published provenance, source warnings and failed attempts?
filters: pinned producer/release; live operational attempt audit separately labeled; selected month filters navigation only

invariants: Monthly distinct customers cannot be summed across months; scalar KPI returns NULL without a single-month context.
Ratios recompute from components; cohort denominator is original cohort size and future cells are absent.
No atomic fact-to-fact joins; payment records/amount are not orders/merchandise value.
No product-level AOV, profit, causal churn, fabricated names or healthcare/telesales claims.
MetricFlow/oracle parity, chart API execution, native month changes and browser rendering require real-run evidence.
